formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ x2 ∈ x1.gates, x2.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x2.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) → Monotone fun (x3 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) => x1.eval (List.ofFn x3)
plain_statement: Every circuit of AND and OR gates on 26 inputs computes a monotone function.
title: A step toward: Order 3 plane: a circuit of at most 64 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
